steps.title: Project Setup
steps.description: Initialize a new Android project with the specified Java and Gradle environment.

steps.title: Generate app-meta.json
steps.description: Create the app-meta.json file at the project root to define the application's name and package.

steps.title: Generate build-steps.json
steps.description: Create the build-steps.json file to outline the development process.

steps.title: Configure AndroidManifest.xml
steps.description: Set up the application manifest, defining the main activity, theme, and necessary configurations.

steps.title: Configure build.gradle
steps.description: Adjust the project's build.gradle file to include the correct SDK versions and dependencies.

steps.title: Design Layout (Display)
steps.description: Create the user interface layout for the calculator, starting with the display area to show numbers and results.

steps.title: Design Layout (Number Buttons)
steps.description: Add buttons for digits (0-9) to the calculator's layout.

steps.title: Design Layout (Operator Buttons)
steps.description: Add buttons for mathematical operations (+, -, *, /, =), and a clear button (C) to the layout.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity.java (Class Structure)
steps.description: Set up the basic structure of MainActivity.java, including member variables for UI elements and calculator state.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity.java (UI Binding)
steps.description: Bind the UI components defined in activity_main.xml to their corresponding Java objects in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity.java (Number Input Handling)
steps.description: Add logic to handle number button clicks, appending digits to the display and building the current number.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity.java (Operator Handling)
steps.description: Add logic for operator button clicks to store the first operand and the selected operation.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity.java (Equals Button Logic)
steps.description: Develop the logic for the equals button to perform the pending calculation and display the result.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity.java (Clear Button Logic)
steps.description: Implement the clear button functionality to reset the calculator's state and clear the display.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity.java (Core Calculation Logic)
steps.description: Create a helper method to perform the actual mathematical operations based on the stored operator.

steps.title: Generate api_schema.json
steps.description: Define the api_schema.json to document the local calculation logic used by the app.

steps.title: Building Calculator App
steps.description: Compile and assemble the Android application.
